name: Cash or card use in border and transit areas near conflict zones
description: Cash withdrawals, ATM or card use occur at transit points or border regions near conflict zones.
fp: Residents, workers and travellers legitimately use these locations.

sources.text: FATF, Terrorist Financing Risk Assessment Guidance (2019)
FATF, Financing of the Terrorist Organisation Islamic State in Iraq and the Levant (ISIL) (2015)
UN Security Council Resolution 2178 (2014) on foreign terrorist fighters

links.name: Funds withdrawn as cash or via ATM in higher-risk border regions
links.ctx: Collected funds are cashed out near conflict zones or high-risk borders shortly after payout.
links.fp: Residents and aid workers also transact in those regions.

links.name: Card and ATM use at transit points near conflict zones
links.ctx: Card or ATM activity in locations commonly used as transit routes to conflict areas, followed by cessation of usage.
links.fp: Tourism, trade, humanitarian and diaspora travel produce overlapping footprints.
